translations.web: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,
translations.bsb: Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received, and in which you stand firm.
translations.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
translations.asv: Now I make known unto you brethren, the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye received, wherein also ye stand,
